name: TestGorilla
summary: TestGorilla sells pre-employment skills tests. Its Free plan includes five skills tests, and its Assessments plans are listed from $215 a month for Core and $520 a month for Plus, billed annually. The feature table lists webcam snapshots and a candidate behavior monitor, and the pricing page says AI scores video responses.

facts.text: The pricing page cites a library of 350 or more science-backed skills tests.
The Free plan includes five essential skills tests with unlimited use, covering areas such as problem solving and time management.

The Behavior monitoring section of the feature table lists a candidate behavior monitor, webcam snapshots, full-screen mode, disabled copy and paste, and multiple attempt prevention. The text read from the page did not show which plan includes each feature.
The pricing page says video responses are AI scored, with three recording attempts per candidate.
